title: Join two 2×2 blocks with two studs overlapping
instruction: Press the red block onto the blue block, connecting exactly two neighbouring studs. Lift the pair by the red block alone so the blue block is at least 2 cm above the table for one second. Set the joined pair down upright and let go for one second. Either row or column is allowed; leave the other two blue studs exposed.
context: Joining toy bricks is a step in assisted play and model building. A two-stud joint must support an overhanging brick; full overlap does not qualify.
setup: Two custom press-fit bricks, designed for solid printed PLA: blue 2×2, 31.8 × 31.8 mm footprint, 12.11 g model mass, body centre (0.26, 0.1, 0.7571) m; red 2×2, 31.8 × 31.8 mm footprint, 12.11 g model mass, body centre (0.2, 0.2, 0.7571) m. Both have 19.2 mm bodies and 4.8 mm-high studs, 9.6 mm in diameter on a 16 mm grid. Studs face up; edges align with X/Y. Oak-coloured 1.10 × 1.30 m tabletop, centre X=0.36 m/Y=0, top Z=0.7475 m. Two YAM arms start in the station ready pose. Fixed layout, seed 0, no jitter. Printable CAD includes socket dimensions.
scoring: 0.25: hold red’s lowest point ≥20 mm above the table for 0.20 s. 0.5: after pickup, seat exactly 2 studs for 0.20 s: each stud/socket centre within 1 mm laterally and 0.75 mm of full insertion, relative tilt ≤3°. Red 2×2 edges must align within 3°; quarter-turns are allowed. 1: also lift blue’s lowest point ≥20 mm for 1 s, holding red only, with all robot surfaces ≥2 mm from blue; then release for 1 s with blue’s bottom within 3 mm of the table, upright within 3°, both arms ≥5 mm clear of both bricks, and each brick stable within 2 mm/5°. Use the final score; separation or wrong alignment removes connection credit. 0: no qualifying pickup, or any brick part leaves X[−0.17,0.89] m/Y[−0.63,0.63] m (20 mm inside the table edges) or falls >15 mm below the tabletop.
reset_notes: Separate the bricks and return them upright to the fixed positions. Replace damaged printed parts.
fidelity: Custom PLA designs at Duplo scale, not official LEGO. Hollow rigid bodies and compliant socket contacts approximate a frictional press fit; no attachment joint. Plastic bending, fracture and print tolerances are not simulated. Fit, insertion force and pull-out force are uncalibrated against physical prints.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0; demo: 1. Dream: 25 requests, 27 attempts, 2 retries across 3 sessions (2 recovered requests); recovery effects are unknown.
